designation: KC-135R radar (Pacer CRAG; model not named)
summary: the radar of the Pacer CRAG avionics upgrade (compass, radar and GPS), carded with the weather radars, a transport's navigation radar's nearest family. The source names no model.

frequency_hz.note: Standard ARINC 708 / ITU aeronautical airborne X-band weather radar center frequency (9.345-9.375 GHz)

power_w.note: Assumed average X-band transmit power for KC-135R Pacer CRAG weather radar (model not named in source)

peak_power_w.note: Assumed pulsed peak transmit power for KC-135R Pacer CRAG weather radar (model not named in source)

peak_gain_dbi.note: Assumed flat-plate weather radar array peak gain (~0.45-0.75 m dish) for KC-135R Pacer CRAG weather radar (model not named in source)

azimuth_limit_deg.note: Standard +/-60 deg forward airborne weather radar azimuth sweep

elevation_limit_deg.note: Standard +/-15 deg airborne weather radar antenna tilt range

beamwidth_deg.note: Assumed 3-dB pencil beamwidth for KC-135R Pacer CRAG weather radar (model not named in source)

range_max_m.note: Standard ~160-180 nmi (300-320 km) airborne weather radar display range

mds_dbz_10km.note: Assumed minimum detectable precipitation reflectivity at 10 km reference range (Probert-Jones equation)
